_comment: Edit this file to update clinic details without changing source code. Placeholders marked [TO BE CONFIGURED] must be completed before launch (see docs/LAUNCH.md).

booking.reschedulePolicy: Free rescheduling up to 6 hours before the appointment. Please call the clinic for urgent changes.

faqs.q: What are the clinic's working hours?
faqs.a: [TO BE CONFIGURED — see Schedule Management in the admin dashboard]

faqs.q: How do I cancel or reschedule?
faqs.a: You can cancel or reschedule online using your appointment reference and registered mobile number, or by calling the clinic.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my visit?
faqs.a: Please bring a photo ID, your mobile number used at booking, and any relevant past prescriptions.

avatar.name: Aarav
avatar.introduction: Hello! Welcome to Dr. XYZ's clinic. I'm the virtual receptionist. I can help you explore the clinic's services, check appointment availability, and book an in-person or online consultation. How may I help you today?
avatar.disclaimer: I'm a virtual assistant for appointments and clinic information — I can't provide medical advice or emergencies help. For medical emergencies in India, call 112 immediately.

bookingConfirmed.subject: Appointment confirmed — {ref}
bookingConfirmed.body: Dear {patientName}, your appointment {ref} with Dr. XYZ is confirmed for {date} at {time} ({modeLabel}). Consultation fee: {fee}. To reschedule or cancel, use your appointment reference at our website or call the clinic.

bookingCancelled.subject: Appointment cancelled — {ref}
bookingCancelled.body: Dear {patientName}, your appointment {ref} scheduled for {date} at {time} has been cancelled. To book again, visit our website or call the clinic.

reminder.subject: Appointment reminder — {ref}
reminder.body: Reminder: your appointment {ref} with Dr. XYZ is on {date} at {time} ({modeLabel}). Please arrive 5 minutes early. To reschedule, use your appointment reference.

syncAlert.subject: Clinic system alert: appointment sync issue
syncAlert.body: Synchronization issue for appointment {ref}: {message}. Please review in the admin dashboard.
